method: Physical source lines, including blank lines, comments and inline examples/tests. Separate tests/drivers and external dependencies excluded except where scope explicitly says otherwise.

ParGeo.scope: Original kdTree.h, kdTreeRange.h and point.h; Parlay and other helpers excluded

ANN.scope: ANN public/internal headers and library sources
